notes:
Use Cases tab landing (CHR-1062). Data: `list_use_cases` (list + facets). Sample project: a large one (Pablo, product owner) to show the list at scale.

**Layout.** `shell-topbar` variant `use-cases` (fourth tab "Use Cases" active) · left panel 296px (sub-nav Use cases | Personas | Data objects, `+` = new use case) · main = detail of the selected use case (same markup as `usecases-detail`, clipped at 900px; the main column scrolls, content centred at max 960px).

**Left panel, top to bottom.**
- Search: title, trigger, goal, outcome and step actions (`query`). `/` focuses it.
- Filters as `uc-filter-chip`: Persona, Status, Tag, Screen (mapped screen), Has variants (toggle). An applied filter is `active` ("Persona: Pablo ×", × clears). Drawn: the Status menu open (`open` + `chrome-menu-item` rows) with **facet counts within the current filters** (Draft, Ready); Ready is checked. Status is the maturity of the spec only (ADR-010): Draft or Ready — no priority, no "Implemented".
- Result line "212 of 1,284 use cases" + sort control showing the current sort. Sort options: **Group A–Z · Title · Status** (CHR-1097; no "Recently changed", Christian 2026-11-16). The open menu is drawn in `usecases-list-sort-menu`.
- Tree grouped by `group` path segments (`mapping/elements` → mapping › elements). `uc-group-row` shows the matching count; rows are `uc-list-row` (title; meta line: status dot, status, variant count). Sorted by Title or Status, the list is flat without group rows.

**Built for thousands.** Groups load collapsed except the path to the selected case; a group renders at most 4 rows, then "Show N more". Implement as a virtualized flat list of visible rows; group counts come from facets, not from loaded rows.

**States (as built; see the tag note "States").**
- Loading: a tree row "Loading…" (ui-2xs, tertiary, one row high) after the loaded rows while the next page loads; on the first load it is the only row. The detail column shows the centred placeholder "Loading…".
- Page error: tree row "Could not load more: <message>" (ui-xs, warning colour) + link button **Retry**; loading never retries by itself.
- No result: the tree is replaced by a status paragraph under the result line (ui-sm, tertiary): "No use case matches these filters." (filters or search active) / "No use cases yet." (none at all).
- Nothing selected: detail placeholder "Select a use case." (centred, tertiary, min-height 240). Selected id gone: "This use case no longer exists.".
- Unreadable files: toast "Some use case files could not be loaded." at the top of the main column, listing up to 5 files and "… and N more", dismiss ×.

**Keyboard.** `role="tree"` / `treeitem` with `aria-expanded`; Up/Down move, Left/Right collapse/expand, Enter opens.

**Flows.** row → `usecases-detail`; + / Edit → `usecases-edit-dialog`; + Variant → `usecases-edit-dialog-variant`; More → `usecases-delete-confirm`; sort control → `usecases-list-sort-menu`; Personas → `usecases-personas`; Data objects → `usecases-data-objects`; variant chip and the coverage hint → `usecases-detail-variant`; Show on screens / target chips → `usecases-mapping`.
